<title level="1" right="Class Feature 17">[Revitalizing Rage](/Classes.aspx?ID=57)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 70

**Class** Barbarian
</column>

---

Your rage sustains you more frequently, leaving you ready to jump into battle anew. Instead of needing to wait 1 minute before you can gain [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) from [Rage](/Actions.aspx?ID=2802) again, you need only to spend at least one full turn not in a Rage.
name: Revitalizing Rage
